title: Binance Margin Adds ALPINE, BAR, CITY & More FDUSD, USDC and BTC Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin has added  Alpine F1 Team Fan Token (ALPINE), FC Barcelona Fan Token (BAR) and Manchester City Fan Token (CITY)  as new borrowable and collateral assets on Cross Margin, as well as new FDUSD, USDC and BTC trading pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin.  Cross Margin Isolated Margin New Trading Pairs ALPINE/USDT ,  BAR/USDT ,  CITY/USDT ,  NEO/USDC ,  SAGA/BTC ,  SAGA/FDUSD ,  WIF/USDC NEO/USDC ,  SAGA/BTC ,  SAGA/FDUSD ,  WIF/USDC New Borrowable Assets ALPINE, BAR, CITY - New Collateral Assets Explore Binance Margin Now! Binance Margin strives to enhance user trading experience by continuously reviewing and expanding the list of trading choices offered on the platform, allowing for greater diversification of user portfolios and flexibility with trading strategies.  Notes: Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates.
